flags.summary: How many check-ins the party has had with Ireena (narrative/allies/ireena:checkin), wherever she was. It picks her greeting; the later Ireena packages (errands, letters, camp talks) may read it (Story Allies Presence Plan, package I1).

How far Ireena trusts the party, a side counter that starts at 0. I1 adds 1 the first time the party checks in on her at each place (the inn, St. Andral's, Krezk, the mansion, the road). I2 adds 1 for the sprig laid and told, each sword lesson that lands, the pool-and-statue story told (What He Wants With Me) and the third letter's secret; I3 takes 1 away once, when Strahd writes to the party about three of her letters left unanswered. Only her own new lines, the finale and the epilogues may read it; it never moves a story flag.

A sword lesson was tried in this check-in (it landed or not); reset by every check-in. One lesson a check-in, so a lesson that did not land is offered again next time.

How many of Ireena's three sword lessons landed (grip and footing, reading an opponent, then drill or the fall). A lesson that did not land is not counted. The finale and the epilogues may read it; it changes no numbers.
The party put off Ireena's ask for what tells the story of her face (What He Wants With Me), so her first sword lesson, if pending, is raised next time instead. Reset when the lesson is raised.
Ismark was at his father's grave when the party laid Ireena's sprig (allies/ireena_errands:grave_scene). It lets the party tell her so.
The party read the Tome of Strahd aloud to Ireena (allies/ireena_errands:tome_start).
The party told Ireena about Marina's statue in Berez, or she saw it herself (allies/ireena_errands:statue_tell).
Ireena has heard the Tome and learned of the statue: she knows whose face she wears (What He Wants With Me, stage knows). It never sets ireena_pool_choice. The finale (F1) reads it.
Ireena showed the party Strahd's first letter to her, after his call at her window or the churchyard gate (allies/ireena_errands:letter_1_open). Told once.
Ireena showed the party Strahd's second letter to her, after the festival (allies/ireena_errands:letter_2_open). Told once.

Ireena told the party about Strahd's third letter to her, with the dinner invitation, and said she burned it; the game knows she kept it (allies/ireena_errands:letter_3_open). Set when the third letter is told, whether or not the party saw through her, and it is the 'told once' mark for that letter. The finale and her epilogues read it.

The party saw through Ireena over the third letter (Insight) and she told them her secret: some nights she wants to lift the latch. She asked them to stop her. Adds 1 to ireena_trust; the finale and her epilogues read it.

How many letters Ireena has sent the party by courier while she sheltered elsewhere (data/visits/ireena.json, narrative/allies/ireena_letters:letter), at most six. No story reads it (Story Allies Presence Plan, package I3).

How many of Ireena's letters have gone without a visit: each letter adds one, and any check-in with her (narrative/allies/ireena:checkin) sets it back to 0. Letters stop coming at three; at two or more her next check-in opens cold, and at three Strahd writes to the party about her. Never moves a story flag.

How cold Ireena opens this check-in: 0, or the number of unanswered letters (2 or 3) the check-in found. Set at the start of every check-in (narrative/allies/ireena:checkin) before the count is cleared; no story reads it.
